procedure: Three stock virtual-host sessions with the P4 holder and SDL 3.4.20, plus one focused SDL button and stick sweep. The isolated Steam retest used build 1794536281. Controller virtualgamepad.dualsense; realization linux.uinput; condition bound. Public Alpha 1 holder and existing SDL3 exact-node probe with HIDAPI enabled/disabled. vg SHA ed8065b4be2c266dd64e9cedba16e87889392a14; research submodule SHA a67781e2412eceea9440d20dbb350ad5d3352c25; kernel 7.3.0-1-mainline; SDL pkg-config 3.4.20. Inputs are sanitized matrix JSON; raw captures and host identifiers are not imported. Related claims are indexed in docs/p5a-host-evidence.md.
semantic_outcome: Session 1: no HID driver, hidapi requested with diagnostic failed; evdev requested with diagnostic failed. Session 2: no HID driver, hidapi requested with diagnostic failed; evdev requested with diagnostic failed. Session 3: no HID driver, hidapi requested with diagnostic passed; evdev requested with diagnostic passed. The P4 diagnostic verdict includes sensor requirements. Its backend classifier does not cover SDL 3.4.20. The exact-path follow-up sweep delivered four face-button press/release transitions and both endpoints on each of the four stick axes over evdev request via event, hidapi request via event. The privileged comparison stopped on the first attempted per-device sysfs write. No physical fidelity or timing qualification is inferred. Steam result. Listed. Four face buttons, both sticks and both individual triggers verified. Ping retained a pulse and stop.
